about.heading: A small brokerage, on purpose.
paragraphs: We started {{brokerageName}} in {{founded}} with two agents and a rented office in Montecito. We are still on the same street, now with eleven agents, and we still turn down more listings than we take.

That is a deliberate choice. Every home we represent is shown by the agent who listed it, priced from comparable sales we have walked through ourselves, and photographed in the light that suits it. We would rather sell fewer houses well than many houses quickly.

principles.title: One agent, start to finish
principles.body: The person who lists your home shows it, negotiates it and is at the closing. Nobody is handed off to a junior colleague.

principles.title: Prices you can defend
principles.body: Every list price comes with the six to ten comparable sales behind it, so you can see exactly where the number came from.

principles.title: Answers the same day
principles.body: Questions about a listing reach the listing agent directly. Our median reply time last year was 38 minutes.

principles.title: Private when you need it
principles.body: Many sellers never want a sign on the lawn. We show those homes quietly, to buyers we have already met.

principles.title: Local before anything else
principles.body: Every agent lives in the area they sell. We know which streets flood and which canyons hold the morning fog.

contactPaths.title: I'm looking to buy
contactPaths.body: Tell us the areas and the kind of house. We'll send homes that match, including ones that haven't reached the market yet.

contactPaths.title: I'm thinking of selling
contactPaths.body: We'll visit, walk the house with you and come back within a week with a price and the sales behind it.

privateListings.heading: Hear about homes before they’re listed.
privateListings.body: About a third of the homes we sell never appear on this site. Owners ask us to show them quietly first. Tell us where you're looking and we'll send them to you as they come in.
privateListings.fine: One or two emails a month. Every one has an unsubscribe link.
privateListings.doneFine: Each email names the agent handling the home, so you can reply straight to them.
